description: Rubash source pin for niubash releases (rubash#827, conclusion B). Every release job fetches exactly this rubash commit into ../rubash -- where the [patch] path override in Cargo.toml deterministically picks it up -- and fails the release unless the checked-out HEAD equals rubash_rev. This is the source-level twin of winuxcmd-pin.json (niubash#312/#327): the bundled WinuxCmd was already pinned, but the compiled engine was 'whatever rubash master HEAD was at build time'.
notes: Recorded from rubash master HEAD a83a09d32b4a4f953d29af0acc0e781b542206b8 (2026-10-20, Cargo.toml version 1.4.1) — includes rubash#909 (child spawn console suppression when parent has no visible console) and rubash#911 (preserve argv[0]-marked login_shell shopt across reset_shell_options).
NOTE: the rev includes #863 — rubash's own Cargo.lock self-entry must be 1.4.1 or the release build's --locked cargo calls (bash shim) fail inside the pinned clone.
Bumping the pin is a deliberate release decision: update rubash_rev and rubash_version together.
